# Frequent background device list expiration notice (2026-04-27 09:50Z)

_**User**_

Requested that the Devices list show a notice above devices when the new frequent background mode is active. The user then asked to separate that notice from the actual device list, make tapping it guide the user to Settings > Advanced Options, and show the expiration time when a finite background-update duration is selected instead of "never".

The user also asked to describe, document, update the changelog, and commit the work.

---

_**Agent**_

Added a shared `FrequentBackgroundLocationUpdatesDeviceListNotice` row and displayed it in its own section above the device list on iPhone and iPad while location tracking and frequent background location updates are active.

Made the notice tappable by routing through `AppNavigationCoordinator.openAdvancedSettings()`, so it switches to the Settings tab and opens Advanced Options. Added a chevron and accessibility hint to make the row read as navigable.

Extended the notice to accept `frequentBackgroundLocationUpdatesExpiresAt`. When a finite expiration date exists, the row shows a localized "Active until ..." line using short date and time formatting. When the mode is set to never expire, the row remains compact and only shows the active-mode message.

Updated localized strings for all supported app languages, documented the behavior in `documentation/frequent-background-device-list-notice-2026-04-27.md`, and updated `CHANGELOG.md` under version 3.1.7.

Verified with:

```sh
ruby -rjson -e 'JSON.parse(File.read(ARGV[0])); puts "valid json"' miataru/miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings
xcodebuild -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
```
